description: Developed a machine learning tool for ECG signal analysis and cardiac health assessment in athletes, integrating models with a desktop application built in MATLAB.
Built a data acquisition, cleaning, and consolidation pipeline for physicians from a web source, delivering a structured database in Excel format.
Developed a desktop computer vision application for segmentation and disease detection in mango leaves using image processing in MATLAB.
Built a large-scale scraping system to extract over 48,000 notary records, generating structured CSV datasets ready for analysis.
Built frontend sections and UI/UX design for a conference website using Réflex, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Designed, developed, and deployed a fullstack website for a client, including a React/TypeScript frontend, functional contact form, basic SEO optimization, and hosting deployment.

Led a 4-person team under Scrum methodology, building three AI solutions for a marketplace: a product-summary generator, an AI chat to assist sellers and buyers, and an AI integration in WhatsApp via Meta's Cloud API, n8n workflows, RAG, and a PostgreSQL database. Internal testing showed we covered 80% of merchants' questions when joining the marketplace and delivered more human-like WhatsApp responses.
